changelog:
Initial release of deepsop-genvis-ai.

- Provides asynchronous AI image and video generation via AI Artist API based on text prompts.
- Supports multiple image models (e.g., 3.1Nano2-Evo, S5.0L, N2, W2.7, Image2) and video models (e.g., V3.1FB, S1.5Pro, klingV3Omni, HappyHorse).
- Requires users to set the AI_ARTIST_TOKEN environment variable with their personal API Key.
- Automatically uploads reference images or videos and polls for task completion.
- Includes detailed user guidance for intent clarification, model selection, and parameter confirmation to improve output quality and avoid unexpected results.
- Output images and videos can be retrieved via markdown links or local downloads; supports integration with chat platforms.
